posts.author: Jem
posts.content_md:
Hi John

I guess those (work) phases come and go. It really sucks when work gets in the way of your hobbies 

I miss your posts as i'm really interested in fiber holography and enjoy reading about what you're up to. I used to do quite a lot of caving in my erm.. younger days. Not sure i'd want to risk some of the potholes I used to go down these days though as my health (and suppleness) isn't what it used to be.

I'd love to see a setup of what you use down the caves and if you've got any photo's of the holograms you've managed to acheive.

Keep well, and very best wishes from the UK.

Cheers

Jem
